arms.BAN: modal-ban of this model's default, W1-W5 x slots 0-9, CRN-paired with TWIN
arms.FORCED: 5 paraphrases x 4 slots per catalogue mode (N=20)
arms.SEED: T2 semantic seed p0-p4 x slots 0-9 (N=50)
arms.NO_DEFAULT: extra twin slots 10-19 instead of a ban

rules.default: modal correct label with share >= 0.6 of correct programs, else NO DEFAULT
rules.Ystar: modal correct non-default label under the ban (W1-W5 pooled) with >= 50% of correct ban programs and >= 10 programs, else BAN-FAILURE
rules.mixed: minority label >= 0.2 of correct programs -> 20 generated-token samples

layer.rule: use hidden_states[20] unless FVE_ref with [21] is higher by >= 0.05

gate.FVE_ref: 1 - mean||p_n-g_n||^2 / mean_ref||g_ref,n - mu_ref||^2 (all normalised to sqrt(d); mu_ref and denominator from the broad reference set)

primary_readout_N1: ban states (eligible task; W1,W2,W3,W5; SPEC-3..READ): x = majority(>=2 of 3) resolved EXPL planned == Y*, y = TEXT-ONLY NAME planned == Y*; PASS iff mean(x)-mean(y) >= 0.30 and exact McNemar p < 0.05
causal_rule: PASS(task) iff for some dose the EDIT-RT excess in Y-share >= 0.20 with Holm(3 doses) exact-McNemar p < 0.05 AND the excess over max(UNREL, RAND) >= 0.10; claim PASSES iff >= 2 tasks pass
judge_rubric_v1: 'planned' = the algorithm the text says is being, or will be, used or implemented; an algorithm that appears only as forbidden or avoided goes to 'negated'; output JSON {planned: mode_id | none_named | other, mentioned: [...], negated: [...]}
